title: Ella Langley’s Dandelion Tour 2026: Here’s Where to Buy Last-Minute Concert Tickets Online
summary: The country music singer/songwriter continues her tour across the United States.
contentText:
All products and services featured are independently chosen by editors. However, Billboard may receive a commission on orders placed through its retail links, and the retailer may receive certain auditable data for accounting purposes.

After earning nine 2026 CMA Awards nominations , including for entertainer of the year, single of the year, album of the year and others, Ella Langley is one of the hottest voices in country music. Right now, the singer/songwriter is on The Dandelion Tour , which heads across the United States with dates in Charleston, Knoxville, Tulsa, Los Angeles and other cities. It ends at Grand Casino Arena in Saint Paul, MN on Saturday, Oct. 31.

Meanwhile, the tour is in support of her latest album, Dandelion , which was released in April. Additionally, there’s a rotating lineup of recording artists who are set to support, including ERNEST, Gabriella Rose, Kameron Marlowe and Laci Kaye Booth.

Shop Ella Langley Tour Tickets At Ticketmaster

Tickets to the tour first went on sale through Live Nation and Ticketmaster , while the retailer’s Face Value Exchange program is an option for fans to resell tickets.

However, many of the dates have either sold out, or are very close to selling out, so one of the best ways to find last-minute Ella Langley tickets online is through third-party sites, such as StubHub , Vivid Seats , SeatGeek , TicketNetwork , Gametime , Event Tickets Center and others. All online retailers guarantee authentic tickets in time for your concert. Prices may be above or below face value at times.

Where to Find Ella Langley The Dandelion Tour 2026 Tickets Online

Find Ella Langley Tickets at TicketNetwork

find tickets at TicketNetwork

Don’t forget TicketNetwork . The retailer has ticket packages, which include parking passes, VIP access, meet and greets and other great experiences. It has tickets to Ella Langley’s concerts with all-in pricing that lets you see exactly what you’ll pay up front (fees included). Tickets start at $105, as of this writing. You can use our exclusive code BILLBOARD150 to save $150 off purchases over $500, or BILLBOARD300 to save $300 off orders of $1000 and up.

And since TicketNetwork is a resale site, the company says that pricing may sometimes be below face value because tickets aren’t held to a specific price point. It guarantees that the tickets you receive are the ones you purchased, and sometimes, even better than expected.
